boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented NAU study environments, from reservable rooms to walk-in seating and technology-supported spaces.

cards.title: Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Cline Library, second and third floors
cards.notes: Reserve an individual room when you need a focused work session; NAU and CCC students may book up to four hours daily, up to two weeks ahead.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for focused individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Cline Library lists individual study rooms and states that NAU and CCC students can reserve them for up to four hours per day.
cards.source_title: Learning and Study Spaces | Cline Library
cards.access_notes: NAU and CCC students; reserve up to four hours per day, up to two weeks in advance.

cards.title: Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Cline Library, floors one through three
cards.notes: Book a group room to plan, rehearse, or work through an assignment together; bring collaborators and keep the session within the two-hour daily limit.
cards.evidence_claim: Cline Library lists group study rooms, including rooms on all three floors, and permits NAU and CCC students to reserve them for two hours per day.
cards.source_title: Learning and Study Spaces | Cline Library
cards.access_notes: NAU and CCC students; reserve up to two hours per day, up to two weeks in advance.

cards.title: Graduate Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Cline Library, third floor
cards.notes: Graduate students can reserve a dedicated room for longer reading or writing blocks; check the scheduler before heading to the third floor.
cards.short_summary: Third-floor reservable rooms for graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Cline Library's floor map identifies graduate study rooms 311–326 on the third floor, and its booking policy allows graduate students four hours per day.
cards.source_title: Learning and Study Spaces | Cline Library
cards.access_notes: Graduate students only; reserve up to four hours per day, up to two weeks in advance.

cards.title: Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Cline Library walk-in space
cards.notes: Use this walk-in quiet area for reading, drafting, or problem sets; choose it when you do not need a reservation or a group setup.
cards.short_summary: A walk-in quiet zone in Cline Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Cline Library identifies the Quiet Study Area as one of its walk-in spaces.
cards.source_title: Learning and Study Spaces | Cline Library
cards.access_notes: Walk-in space; confirm building access and current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Open Computers
cards.subtitle: Cline Library walk-in space
cards.notes: Set up at an open computer when your work needs a desktop station; the library lists computer access among its walk-in study options.
cards.short_summary: Walk-in computer access at Cline Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Cline Library lists Open Computers among its walk-in spaces and describes campus computing access with workstations, Wi-Fi, printing, and scanning.
cards.source_title: Learning and Study Spaces | Cline Library
cards.access_notes: Walk-in space; verify availability and current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Open Seating
cards.subtitle: Cline Library walk-in space
cards.notes: Use open seating for a flexible laptop session or a quick reading block; it is a walk-in option, so arrive ready to choose an available seat.
cards.short_summary: Flexible walk-in seating in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Cline Library identifies Open Seating as a walk-in learning and study space.
cards.source_title: Learning and Study Spaces | Cline Library
cards.access_notes: Walk-in space; confirm building access and current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: The Learning Studio
cards.subtitle: Cline Library Room 249
cards.notes: Use the Learning Studio for technology-supported collaborative work; its writable glass, mobile tables, displays, and videoconferencing tools suit planned group sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU says the Learning Studio in Cline Library Room 249 seats 70 and includes writable glass, mobile tables, displays, and videoconferencing tools.
cards.source_title: Cline Library learning and study spaces | NAU
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to library scheduling and access policies; check current availability before planning a session.

cards.title: The MakerLab
cards.subtitle: Cline Library Room 180
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from making or prototyping; the MakerLab provides 3D printers, a Glowforge laser cutter, and project consultations during library hours.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on workspace for project-based learning.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU describes the MakerLab as a creative workspace with 3D printers, a Glowforge laser cutter, and project consultations, available during regular library hours.
cards.source_title: Cline Library learning and study spaces | NAU
cards.access_notes: Available during regular library hours; consult staff for equipment use and current availability.

cards.entity_name: Health and Learning Center Second Floor Study Spaces
cards.title: Health and Learning Center Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Health and Learning Center, second floor
cards.notes: Choose a desk, chair, couch with side table, or private study room depending on the task; use the second floor when you need solo or group flexibility.
cards.short_summary: Mixed seating and private rooms in the Health and Learning Center.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU states that the Health and Learning Center's second floor has desks, chairs, couches with side tables, and private study rooms.
cards.source_title: Campus learning and study spaces | NAU
cards.access_notes: Check current building access and private-room availability before visiting.

cards.title: University Union Second Floor
cards.subtitle: University Union, second floor
cards.notes: Settle into the second-floor lounge area for a laptop session or to meet classmates; pair the visit with Academic Student Success Center support if useful.
cards.short_summary: Lounge-style study and gathering space in the Union.
cards.evidence_claim: NAU identifies the University Union, especially its second floor, as a place with lounge areas and space to study and gather; it also houses the Academic Student Success Center.
cards.source_title: Campus learning and study spaces | NAU
cards.access_notes: Check current University Union access and service hours before visiting.
